args.message:
Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

The docstring claimed banker's rounding but the implementation used
ROUND_HALF_UP, causing test_money.py (nightly) to fail. Switch the
quantize call to ROUND_HALF_EVEN per FIN-212.

args.head: fix/fin-212-bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212
args.body:
The nightly build failed because tests/test_money.py expects banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN), but src/money.py implemented round_money with ROUND_HALF_UP even though its docstring claimed banker's rounding per FIN-212.

Changes:
- Switch the Decimal.quantize call in src/money.py from ROUND_HALF_UP to ROUND_HALF_EVEN.

Tests: `round_money(Decimal("2.675")) == Decimal("2.68")` and `round_money(Decimal("2.665")) == Decimal("2.66")` (banker's rounding).

CI run ci-0001 passed on commit 08d3cd5986. This should ship in today's release.
